_doc: Hand overrides, per city QID. The level rule (spec 3) is a good default, not an
`excludeNames` are case-insensitive regexes matched against the OSM name, applied at
ingest so level statistics and the browser agree. Scoped to one city on purpose.
Either field may be omitted; omitting `keep` leaves the rule's own choice in place.

_why: DELHI. Its admin=9 holds 161 units that are two different things under one
admin_level: 45 real Delhi areas (Vikaspuri, Karol Bagh, Rohini, Vasant Kunj,
Saket, Najafgarh) and 116 numbered planned-colony sectors, most of them Noida's
and Gurgaon's. Nothing general separates them - core cannot, because Dwarka's and
Rohini's sectors really are in Delhi (28 of 69 core units are 'Sector N'); P31
cannot, at 3% wikidata; area spread cannot, because legitimate divisions vary more
admin=10 is dropped rather than filtered: stripping sectors still leaves 1,106
units called 'DDA Flats', 'Pkt-B Sec-A', 'B-5', 'Silver Oak Apartments'. Those are
housing blocks, not areas, and no name rule rescues them.
